in_sanskrit.name: Nakysha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nak = New, Yasha = Joy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nakysha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nak’ meaning new and ‘Yasha’ meaning joy. It is a name that brings a sense of new beginnings and happiness.

in_hindi.name: Nakysha
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nak = New, Yasha = Joy
in_hindi.long_meaning: Nakysha एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nak’ meaning new and ‘Yasha’ meaning joy. It is a name that brings a sense of new beginnings and happiness.

in_tamil.name: Nakysha
